scope: Synthetic geometry and single-forward resource feasibility only; no task accuracy, data or training.

checkpoint.license: Apache-2.0 publisher model card; code MIT; training-image provenance unknown

geometry.prompt: Exact native crop at top-left, white RGB right/bottom padding; no resize.
geometry.mask: Class1 white inside crop; class0 black on synthetic padding. Default prompt patches visible, target patches masked.
geometry.target: Synthetic 448x448 RGB field; score only original valid area.
geometry.unknown_pixels: No dataset, annotations, known/unknown labels, document IDs or drawing metadata are accessed.

score: Clipped decoded RGB arithmetic mean /255, equivalent to normalized squared-distance palette margin. Not a probability. Equality at .5 chooses class0 in nearest-color classification.

gates.geometry: Exact synthetic pixel/palette/default-mask assertions must pass before forward.

failure_behavior: Record failure, preserve v2, stop this resource branch; no silent dtype/device/resize/padding fallback.
next_step: Resource pass permits designing a separately frozen fit-only efficacy protocol. Does not justify adoption or public evaluation.
